Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” as the mother of the father’s father and followed the patrilineal line to Antoine de Bourbon’s mother (Françoise d’Alençon), instead of identifying the father’s mother. The correct paternal grandmother is Henry IV’s mother, Jeanne d’Albret.
